text:
samir: Quick idea — add a 6-dot sparkline per host showing the last 6 probe results (green/amber/red) so SREs can spot flakiness without expanding rows. mock: https://www.figma.com/file/sparks/probe-history (frame: host-spark). Thoughts? :sparkles:
olga: Love the glanceability. accessibility concern: color-only encoding is bad. we need a text alternative and at least one non-color pattern (e.g., dot fill + slash). tooltip should show a short summary like "Last 6: ok, ok, flaky, ok, ok, fail".
mei: For screen readers, DO NOT announce each dot. Use a single aria-label on the sparkline: "Recent: 4 ok, 1 flaky, 1 failed". expose the detailed sequence only on request.
harry: Animation note: animate the sparkline changes with a subtle fade, avoid layout reflow. respect `prefers-reduced-motion` and provide an instant update mode for keyboard users.
a11y-bot: Checklist: provide accessible name (`aria-label`), role="img" with `aria-hidden=false`? better: role="group" + aria-label. include a legend (focusable) and ensure contrast for amber/red >= 3:1 against background. announce aggregate status via summary band, not each sparkline update.
samir: Microcopy proposals: banner: "Network checks  5 of 8 healthy" (using 'healthy' for brevity); sparkline tooltip: "Last 6: ok, ok, flaky, ok, ok, fail"; legend label: "History legend: ok, flaky, fail".
olga: Mobile fallback: collapse sparklines into a compact badge like `2F` (2 failures) with an expand chevron to reveal full history. ensure tap target >=44px.
mei: Keyboard interactions: tab to sparkline -> Enter toggles persistent readout (shows textual sequence) -> Escape dismisses. ensure readout is focusable and announced via `aria-live` when revealed.
figma-bot: New figma version uploaded by samir at 2026-03-24T12:00:00Z.
samir: I'll update Figma with non-color patterns, a legend button, and the keyboard readout flow. will open a tiny spec PR and tag @olga @mei for a11y sign-off. :thumbsup:
